meta.name: stakeholder-identification
meta.description: Map every stakeholder before engaging anyone. Use when launching an initiative, scoping discovery, or building an engagement plan from scratch.

copy.tagline: 梳理项目所有相关方，制定参与计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统识别和管理项目中的关键干系人
copy.tagline_en: Map all stakeholders and plan their engagement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify and manage key stakeholders in your project

howto.what: Claude 会引导你系统性地识别所有利益相关者，包括容易被忽略的群体，并分类标记（盟友/受众/影响者、资源/许可/决策），最后选出2-3个优先深入了解的对象。
howto.when: 当你启动新项目、规划探索性研究或从头制定参与计划时，可以调用此技能。

say.text: 帮我识别这个新项目的所有利益相关者。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成六步识别流程。

say.text: 我们现有的利益相关者列表可能漏了谁？
say.note: Claude 会应用公平性视角检查盲点。

say.text: 为我的PRD准备利益相关者部分。
say.note: Claude 会输出分类标记的完整列表。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a structured process to identify all stakeholders, including often-missed groups, categorize them (Allies/Audiences/Influencers, R/P/D marking), and narrow to 2-3 priority targets for deep understanding.
howto.when_en: Use when launching a new initiative, scoping discovery, or building an engagement plan from scratch.

say_en.text: Identify all stakeholders for this new initiative.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through the six-step process.

say_en.text: Who might we be missing in our stakeholder list?
say_en.note: Claude applies an equity lens to uncover blind spots.

say_en.text: Prepare the stakeholder section of my PRD.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a categorized, tagged list.
